title: AML Model Definition
description: Compiled JSON payload for an AML model definition (.model.md). Validates that the compiled output conforms to the AML v1.2 specification.

spec_version.title: Spec Version
spec_version.description: AML format version. Must equal a platform-approved version string.

model_id.title: Model ID
model_id.description: Stable, immutable identifier for this model entry. Used as the value of runtime.model in agent definitions. Cannot change once published.

version.title: Version
version.description: Semantic version of this model definition. Increment whenever provider config, capabilities, or defaults change.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. active=usable; deprecated=usable but triggers lint warning on referencing agents; disabled=hard compile error on reference.

meta.title: Metadata
meta.description: Descriptive metadata for this model entry.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the model registry UI and compiler output.

description.title: Description
description.description: One to two sentences describing the model, its strengths, and recommended use cases.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Team or individual responsible for maintaining this model entry.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Searchable labels for discovery and filtering.

last_updated.title: Last Updated
last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last update to this model definition.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Provider declaration. 'type' selects the provider; 'config' holds the provider-specific settings validated against the declared type.

type.title: Type
type.description: Provider type. bedrock=Amazon Bedrock; anthropic=Anthropic direct API; openai=OpenAI or compatible; litellm=LiteLLM unified interface; ollama=Ollama local models; llamaapi=Llama API (Meta); mistral=Mistral AI; writer=Writer (Palmyra); custom=custom provider.

config.title: Configuration
config.description: Provider-specific configuration. Shape is validated against the declared 'type' via oneOf.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Declared capabilities of this model. Used by the compiler to validate agent configurations.

context_window.title: Context Window
context_window.description: Maximum context window size in tokens.

max_output_tokens.title: Max Output Tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens this model can generate in a single call.

supports_tools.title: Supports Tools
supports_tools.description: If true, the model's API natively supports the tool/function-calling protocol — the runtime can pass structured tool definitions in the request and receive a structured tool_use response block. This is a model-level API capability, not an agent behaviour. Agents with a non-empty tools section require this to be true.

supports_system_prompt.title: Supports System Prompt
supports_system_prompt.description: If true, this model accepts a system prompt as a separate input.

supports_streaming.title: Supports Streaming
supports_streaming.description: If true, this model supports streaming token-by-token output.

modalities.title: Modalities
modalities.description: Input modalities supported by this model.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Default inference parameters for this model. Agents may override these in their runtime section.

stop_sequences.title: Stop Sequences
stop_sequences.description: Default stop sequences. Generation halts when any of these strings is produced.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: Compiled from the Markdown body of the .model.md file. Intended for the model registry documentation UI. Sections are optional but validated when present.

description.title: Description
description.description: Compiled from the optional '# Description' section. Prose description of the model: what it is, when to use it, and usage guidance.

aml_id.title: AML ID
aml_id.description: Stable, immutable AML identifier. Lowercase kebab-case or snake_case. Must match ^[a-z0-9_-]{3,64}$.

secret_ref.title: Secret Reference
secret_ref.description: Reference to a secret stored in an external secrets manager or environment variable.

source.title: Source
source.description: iam_role=AWS IAM role, no extra fields required; env=single environment variable; service-account=JSON secret containing AWS credentials (access_key_id + secret_access_key); aws_secrets_manager=AWS Secrets Manager; gcp_secret_manager=GCP Secret Manager; azure_key_vault=Azure Key Vault.

name.title: Name
name.description: Environment variable name. Required when source=env.

secret_id.title: Secret ID
secret_id.description: Secret identifier in the backend store. Required when source=aws_secrets_manager or source=service-account. For service-account, the resolved secret must be a JSON object containing access_key_id and secret_access_key.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key within the secret JSON object, if the secret is a JSON map.

project.title: Project
project.description: GCP project ID. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: GCP secret name. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

vault_url.title: Vault URL
vault_url.description: Azure Key Vault URL. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

secret_name.title: Secret Name
secret_name.description: Azure Key Vault secret name. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

source.title: Source
source.description: workload_identity=use GCP Workload Identity Federation; service_account_key=use a service account key file; env=use GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS env var.

service_account_key.title: Service Account Key
service_account_key.description: Reference to the service account key. Required when source=service_account_key.

region.title: Region
region.description: AWS region where Bedrock is invoked.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: AWS credentials strategy. Use source=iam_role (default, recommended for production) or source=service-account with a secret_id pointing to a JSON object containing access_key_id and secret_access_key.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Reference to the Anthropic API key secret.

provider_openai.title: Provider Openai
provider_openai.description: OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible API provider configuration.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Reference to the OpenAI API key secret.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Optional base URL override for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

model.title: Model
model.description: LiteLLM model string in provider/model format.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Reference to the API key secret for the underlying provider.

extra_params.title: Extra Params
extra_params.description: Additional LiteLLM parameters passed verbatim to the provider.

model.title: Model
model.description: Ollama model name as listed in 'ollama list'.

host.title: Host
host.description: Ollama server host URL. Defaults to http://localhost:11434 if omitted.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Reference to the Llama API key secret.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Reference to the Mistral API key secret.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Reference to the Writer API key secret.

provider_custom.title: Provider Custom
provider_custom.description: Custom provider configuration for models not covered by built-in providers.

class_path.title: Class Path
class_path.description: Fully qualified Python class implementing the Strands Model interface.

config.title: Configuration
config.description: Arbitrary configuration object passed to the custom provider constructor.
